example_sentences_in_bangla: এই সময় নরম বাজারে কেনাকাটা করা উচিত।
বাজার নরম হয়ে গেছে, দামগুলো কমছে।
example_sentences_in_english: It's a soft market right now, so prices are dropping.
Shopping during a soft market is advisable as commodity prices tend to fall.
note: This idiom is commonly used in Bengali economic discussions to describe weakening market conditions.
